payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_home_lock.py::test_a_batch_beside_a_live_task_leaves_it_in_its_state stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cell/session.py. The claim was 'A batch started beside a live task leaves that task in its in-flight state, and stamps nothing `ORPHANED`. The witness drives one live task per holder. A running batch holds a task in `REVIEWING`, a running cell one in `IMPLEMENTING`, and a running draft one in `QUEUED`. The second batch is the real `_batch`, whose scan would stamp each one.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_types_names_its_tool_and_passes_on_a_clean_tree, tests/test_session.py::test_a_cell_reports_each_phase_state_as_it_enters_it, tests/test_session.py::test_a_second_cut_at_one_spec_sha_settles_the_spec, tests/test_session.py::test_a_second_cut_on_a_resumed_row_settles_the_spec, tests/test_session.py::test_a_lens_that_errored_ends_its_task_in_a_state_no_batch_scan_takes_back, tests/test_session.py::test_what_the_task_spent_is_the_sum_of_the_turns_it_ran, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
